findings.claim: scope_conflict_log entry CF-01: mandatory training-activities requirement (SR-04 / CC-09) — integration of transferable and digital skills incl. generative AI, Open Science, knowledge valorisation, research integrity — is not described in the concept; resolution_status = 'unresolved', resolution_note = null.

scope_conflict_log entry CF-02: mandatory Career Development Plan deliverable (SR-05 / CC-10), jointly established and submitted as an early deliverable, is not described in the concept material; resolution_status = 'unresolved', resolution_note = null.

scope_conflict_log entry CF-03: framing mismatch between the concept's scientific/technological framing and MSCA-PF expected outcomes EO-03/EO-04/EO-05/EO-06/EO-08 (fellow-development and institutional capacity), which lack a direct project mechanism; resolution_status = 'unresolved', resolution_note = null.

scope_conflict_log entry CF-04: non-academic placement added-value justification (CC-05 / SR-06) not yet presented as the integral, separately-evaluated justification required; resolution_status = 'unresolved', resolution_note = null.

scope_coverage marks SR-04, SR-05, CC-09 and CC-10 with coverage_status = 'unresolved' ('Mandatory requirement with no Tier 3 evidence'), corresponding to Tier 2B mandatory (mandatory=true) requirements SR-04 and SR-05 in scope_requirements.json.

failed.fail_message: The Phase 2 concept refinement summary records four unresolved scope conflicts (CF-01 through CF-04) and multiple 'unresolved' mandatory scope-coverage elements against Tier 2B, so the §7 Phase 2 gate condition of no unresolved scope conflicts is not satisfied.
